Patrick Hand, designed by Patrick Wagesreiter
License: SIL Open Font License 1.1 (see PatrickHand-OFL.txt).

Original font:
https://github.com/google/fonts/blob/main/ofl/patrickhand/PatrickHand-Regular.ttf
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/google/fonts/main/ofl/patrickhand/PatrickHand-Regular.ttf
Original SHA-256:
0f173b3e6cb6d1af25babf7f0057c5ac4ee11f9992b0469bb817e967ef4ad0fc

PatrickHand-ASCII.woff is an ASCII-only WOFF subset, created with fonttools 4.68.0:
python -m fontTools.subset PatrickHand-Regular.ttf --unicodes=U+0020-007E --flavor=woff --name-IDs='*' --name-legacy --name-languages='*' --output-file=PatrickHand-ASCII.woff

The star history renderer embeds this font and its license in each generated SVG.
Daily generation uses only Python's standard library; fonttools is needed only
to rebuild the font subset.
